attendance_policy: Attendance is not compulsory, but regularity in theory and practical classes will be a decisive factor during grading, especially in borderline cases. Laboratory attendance is a must and no make-up will be given for it (except medical urgency).
makeup_policy: Generally, make-up will be considered for regular students only as per the university rule. It is solely dependent on the ‘genuineness’ of the circumstances. The make-up application should be personally given to instructor-in-charge.
